description: D127 and D151, the Vitest values: two files in one worker (`fileParallelism: false`) each load the externalized packages `hooker` (registers a `beforeEach` as it loads) and `patcher` (writes `globalThis.__patched` as it loads). Whether the second file sees its own hook run once and the patched global (each package evaluated again for the file) is what `module.reevaluateHookingExternals` and `module.reevaluatePatchingExternals` claim.
